role: Historical survey references, independent of radar processing
coordinate_convention: Local metres: x east, y north, z up. Each structure has its own historical vertical datum; no georeferenced target mask is assigned.

models.name: Idu
models.source_title: Simpson, The Mastabas of Qar and Idu (1976), p. 29, Fig. 13
models.status: Simplified survey model · not recovered from SAR
models.datum: 0 m = historical shaft mouth. Rock begins 2.34 m below the mouth; the modern ground datum is not established.
assumptions: The shaft is represented by its published average square width. Uneven walls are simplified.
The chamber opens south and extends west. The trapezoid uses the reported east/west lengths; its exact angles and junction are simplified from Fig. 13.
The model places the chamber floor at the shaft bottom. Its 5.89 m roof depth is derived from that alignment and the reported 2.16 m height, not independently surveyed here.
Sarcophagus, rubble, wall texture and minor irregularities are omitted. This is an envelope of the excavated spaces, not a watertight engineering survey.
models.acquisition_state: Cover, access, fill and use on 27 August 2025 are unverified.

models.name: Hetepheres I
models.source_title: Reisner & Smith, A History of the Giza Necropolis II (1955), pp. 13–15, Figs. 19 & 21
models.status: Simplified survey model · not recovered from SAR
models.datum: 0 m = historical pit mouth. Pit-bottom and chamber-roof depths are distinct measurements.
assumptions: The full shaft is drawn at its measured bottom section, 1.30 m east–west by 1.14 m north–south. The wider mouth (2.37 × 1.75 m), narrowing, turns, stairs and offering niche are omitted.
The rectangular room uses 2.72 m, the midpoint of the reported width range, and the measured 5.22 m southern extension. Its precise lateral offset is simplified.
The chamber floor at 27.45 m is derived from the observed roof at 25.50 m and measured height of 1.95 m. The 3 cm difference from the reported pit bottom is retained, not forced into agreement.
The report's conjectured original height of 3.16 m is not used. Masonry packing and contents are not modelled.
models.acquisition_state: The shaft was originally packed with masonry. Modern cover and fill on 27 August 2025 are unverified.

additional_references.name: Osiris Shaft
additional_references.description: Three connected levels below Khafre’s causeway. The published section places the lowest main floor about 33.45 m below its causeway datum; the trench extends to 35.45 m. Shaft lengths must not simply be added.
additional_references.qualification: A detailed 3D model needs digitized plans tied to the section. Lowest-level water and current fill also need qualification. No model or target mask is assigned yet.
